user.title: LG Professional Display
user.description: Enter the LG display address and port. Display settings, including the preview camera, follow in the next step.

settings.title: Configure LG display

data.notification_wake_display: Allow notifications/content to wake the display
data.native_web_enabled: Enable native LG web access (tested on UH5F-H)
data.native_web_password: LG Mobile URL password (blank keeps saved password)

data_description.native_web_fingerprint: Read from the display on save and stored for subsequent connections. An existing fingerprint is not replaced automatically.
data_description.native_web_verify_certificate: Enabled by default. Disabling verification keeps HTTPS encryption but does not verify the identity of the display.
data_description.preview_active_interval: Capture faster while the remote preview or enlarged view is open, then return to the normal interval. Default: 1 second. Set 0 to disable acceleration. Actual frame rate is limited by the display capture speed.

settings.description: Confirm the display settings before finishing setup. For the preview camera, enable native LG web access and screenshot preview and enter the Mobile URL password. Leave the fingerprint blank for automatic detection. All settings can be changed later through Configure.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the display. Please check the IP address and port.
error.invalid_native_web_settings: Provide the Mobile URL password and, if entered, a valid SHA-256 fingerprint; leave the fingerprint blank for automatic detection.
error.preview_requires_web: Enable native LG web access before enabling preview.
error.invalid_preview_interval: The normal screenshot interval must be between 1 and 3600 seconds.
error.cannot_read_certificate: Cannot read the LG HTTPS certificate. Check web access on port 3777, enter a fingerprint, or explicitly disable certificate verification.
